guide_title: BiteShark Unfilled Design Style Guide & Decision Questionnaire

mandatory_invariants.title: Server-Enforced RBAC, Vendor Ownership, CSRF & Row-Level Security
mandatory_invariants.summary: UI role switches, hidden buttons, and viewpoint previews are convenience affordances only; backend routes must enforce live row-locked RBAC (Customer, Vendor Staff, Vendor Owner, Admin: Mod, Admin: Top), CSRF checks, and PostgreSQL FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY GUCs.

mandatory_invariants.title: 14+ Age Eligibility, Derived-Only DOB Storage & Private Data Isolation
mandatory_invariants.summary: Accounts require 14+ Pacific-time eligibility without storing raw birthdates; customer visit notes and private photos remain private to the owning account with EXIF stripped; diagnostics and logs never expose secrets, OTPs, cookies, or raw PII.

mandatory_invariants.title: Keyboard Operability, Visible Focus, Pinch-Zoom & Live Announcements
mandatory_invariants.summary: Every interactive control must remain keyboard-reachable with a visible, usable focus indicator; modals must manage focus and Escape dismissal; viewport pinch-zoom must never be disabled; dynamic errors and status changes must be announced accessibly. Unanswered visual parameters are never labeled as accessibility compliance.

mandatory_invariants.title: Sonoma County Truthfulness, Non-Fabricated Status & Draft Policy Honesty
mandatory_invariants.summary: Never fabricate star ratings, review counts, verified statuses, live locations, stock photos, instant reservations, or legal sign-off. Distinguish verified vendor data from unclaimed/estimated directory info, label illustrations honestly, and retain draft legal notices until approved in Readiness.

topics.title: Foundations & Design Tokens
topics.scope_summary: Brand attributes, semantic and surface color roles, light/dark theme policy, CSS token naming and consolidation, spacing/sizing scales, borders/radii/elevation, z-index layering, and density.

topics.title: Typography & Text Hierarchy
topics.scope_summary: Font families and fallbacks across customer, vendor, admin, and policy surfaces, weights, semantic text roles, type scale/line-height/tracking, link and emphasis treatments, and long-name wrapping.

topics.title: Layout, Grids & Responsive Behavior
topics.scope_summary: Container widths, grids, gutters, breakpoints, mobile safe-area insets, sticky/fixed region budgets, page vs pane scrolling, and 200%-400% zoom reflow.

topics.title: Navigation, Wayfinding & Role Switching
topics.scope_summary: Top header, mobile bottom navigation, segmented switches and tabs, account/overflow dropdowns, back/history behavior, active states, role/viewpoint switching, and feature-hidden navigation.

topics.title: Forms, Inputs & Validation
topics.scope_summary: Text inputs, search fields, textareas, selects, searchable pickers, checkboxes/radios/switches, date/time/range inputs, file uploads, 14+ DOB & OTP inputs, labels, help text, validation, and submission/retry states.

topics.title: Buttons, Links & Destructive Actions
topics.scope_summary: Primary/secondary/ghost/danger/icon buttons, width behavior across layouts, button-vs-link rules, loading/disabled states, and destructive confirmation patterns.

topics.title: Cards, Listings, Badges, Tables & Pagination
topics.scope_summary: Unified horizontal listing cards and compact variants, business detail views, favorites, chips/tags/status/role badges, admin data tables, search/filter/sort bars, and pagination/incremental loading.

topics.title: Dialogs, Sheets, Popovers & Disclosures
topics.scope_summary: Modal dialogs across main app, role-experience, and admin portal, map/list sheet, inline <details> disclosures, dropdown popovers, stacking rules, and unconfirmed tooltip policy.

topics.title: Feedback, Banners, Loading & Recovery States
topics.scope_summary: Toasts, banners, inline notices, skeletons/spinners, empty/error/offline states, sign-in/session-expiry prompts, and feature-paused or disabled messaging.

topics.title: Imagery, Fallbacks, Illustrations & Icons
topics.scope_summary: Approved vendor photos, unverified-listing fallback badges, editorial illustrations, private customer photos, mascot characters, and icon system consolidation.

topics.title: Maps, Markers, Area Selection & Location Confidence
topics.scope_summary: Interactive Leaflet map, pin states, overlap/clustering, legends and illustration disclosures, live vs estimated vs coarse town location confidence, manual area picker, and map-unavailable fallback.

topics.title: Domain & Specialized Role Interfaces
topics.scope_summary: Onboarding, event inquiries, pickup pagers, community & moderation, stories/visit journal/private photos/badges/trails, vendor operations, support threads, admin portal/Feature Controls/diagnostics/readiness, legal policy drafts, and unconfirmed candidate features.

topics.title: Accessibility Presentation Decisions
topics.scope_summary: Visual focus ring parameters, contrast targets at or above WCAG AA, target sizing/spacing above 44px floor, skip-link appearance, non-color cues, and announcement verbosity (while preserving mandatory accessibility invariants).

topics.title: Content, Voice, Formatting & Truthful Disclosures
topics.scope_summary: Voice and tone by surface, capitalization and action labels, Pacific date/time formatting, Imperial distance/unit formatting, privacy disclosures, verified vs self-reported labeling, and error honesty.

topics.title: Motion, Micro-Interactions & Reduced Motion
topics.scope_summary: Permitted motion roles, duration and easing scales, screen/modal/sheet transitions, favorite/pager micro-interactions, prefers-reduced-motion behavior, and programmatic scroll behavior.
